title: rosa lutetiana subsp. dumetorum
intro: Rosa lutetiana subsp. dumetorum, commonly known as wild rose, is a species of wild rose that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa lutetiana subsp. dumetorum include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
